If you want extra privacy, upload one file first and confirm it shows as received before sending the rest. We can do it step by step, and you can stop anytime.

voiceResponseAlternatives: Yes, you can. Go to the **Proof Center** in your wallet, then open the dental visit proof file. From there, you usually have two choices: **Show QR code** or **Export/Share**. If you want your daughter to print it, choose **Export** and send the PDF to her. If the clinic wants to scan, choose **Show QR code**. I can walk you tap-by-tap, slowly, if you’d like.
